summary: New Jersey activist James O'Keefe built Project Veritas on deceptively edited undercover stings, from the 2009 ACORN videos to attacks on Planned Parenthood, NPR, Democrats and Google, harming targets with distorted evidence.

evidence.note: Birth in Bergen County, New Jersey; year garbled in transcript, 1984 from general knowledge
Long segment on his Rutgers columns, campus bias complaints and founding The Centurion
2009 Planned Parenthood phone stings with Lila Rose cost the group state funding
2009 ACORN pimp-and-prostitute videos in eight cities; main span starts with this period
2010 Landrieu office break-in leads to conviction and probation
Voter-fraud stings and 2016 Clinton campaign videos forcing staffer resignations
Pivot to Silicon Valley bias claims: Twitter, Google video and 2019 Vorhees leak
Latest events covered are the August 2019 Google whistleblower release

notes: Part one of a two-part pairing; the next part is about Andy Ngo, so this story covers O'Keefe only. Transcript garbles the birth date; 1984 is from general knowledge. Project Veritas tagged ngo (it is a nonprofit), though political-org is arguable.
